name: La Pluma (羽毛笔) -- recruitment film
notes: Rebuilt from the reference video named by the environment variable LAPLUMA_REFERENCE (1920 x 1080, 30 fps); frame numbers are the video's own.

The cast's .blend is named by the environment variable LAPLUMA_BLEND (or --cast LaPluma=<path>).  Its shading is runtime data of the RuriRipperImporter add-on, which must be enabled in the Blender that builds the film.

LaPluma.note: The coat -- its shell, sleeves and iridescent lining, and the proxy meshes its rig is being built on -- is not rigged yet and stays hidden until it is.
